# Base rate held at 3.75%

The central bank held its base rate at 3.75% on Wednesday, the third meeting in a row without a change, The Forth Ledger reports. The committee voted six to three, with three members preferring a cut.

The bank said inflation was falling more slowly than it had hoped, and the next decision is due on 5 November.

If you are on a fixed rate, nothing changes until your deal ends. If you are on a variable rate, lenders said their pricing already reflected the hold.

If we were in your shoes, we would fix for five years before the November decision rather than wait and see.

Either way, the date your current deal ends is printed on your annual statement, and it is the first thing to look for.
